en.hero_lead: Built to work as a full loop, or deployed where the need is greatest.
en.hf_c_sub: We stay until value is captured
en.a_h2:
We build the visibility
that does not exist yet.
en.a_lead: Most organizations cannot see their market clearly, not because the data doesn't exist, but because it has never been consolidated into a single reliable base. Arm A resolves that before anything else can be attempted.
en.a_s1_body: ERP, sales systems, and billing records, the data the client already owns but rarely consolidates.
en.a_s2_body: Point-of-sale capture from fragmented traditional trade where traceability is typically low.
en.a_s3_body: Transactional data from structured retail chains and modern trade formats.
en.a_s4_body: Structured connections to receive and map sales, coverage, pricing, and promotional data.
en.a_s5_body: Third-party aggregated sources for benchmarking and market-level reads.
en.a_s6_body: SKU master data, price lists, promotional calendars, and inventory records.
en.a_u1_body: In-field capture for prices, inventory, promotions, visibility, competitive presence, and compliance.
en.a_u2_body: Route-level intelligence from commercial teams operating at the point of sale.
en.a_u3_body: Assortment compliance, share of shelf, pricing execution, and promotional display tracking.
en.a_u4_body: Observed competitor pricing at point of sale by channel, region, and format.
en.a_u5_body: External research and category benchmarks that provide context beyond internal data.
en.a_u6_body: Demand-side intelligence to complement supply-side and transactional data.
en.a_p1_body: Direct capture from POS systems, surveys, apps, and integrations. The entry point for all commercial information.
en.a_p2_body: Technical loading of multiple sources into a common architecture, regardless of format, cadence, or origin.
en.a_p3_body: Correction, validation, deduplication, and resolution of inconsistencies. A reliable base starts here.
en.a_p4_body: Standardization of SKUs, customers, channels, and geographies so data becomes comparable across sources.
en.a_p5_body: Generation of structured, usable datasets for analytics, benchmarking, and eventual monetization.
en.b_lead: Thirteen analytical capabilities that turn structured commercial data into prioritized decisions, organized in four families. Trade-offs made explicit. Decisions, not reports.
en.c_h2:
We stay until
the value is captured.
en.c_lead: Most engagements stop at the recommendation. Arm C is where the work becomes real, intelligence translated into field action, measured against baseline, and fed back into the operation.
en.c_gap_note: The distance between a good analysis and a measurable commercial result is where most consulting engagements fail. We do not hand off a deck and disengage.
en.c_i1_body: B output converted into a specific, sequenced action list, what gets done first, what gets done second, what does not get done at all, with responsible owners and timelines.
en.c_i2_body: Decisions structured into field-ready plans by commercial, trade, key account, and territory, with the specificity required for execution, not just communication.
en.c_i3_body: We do not hand off the plan. We work alongside the teams responsible for execution until the logic operates on its own, training, real-time support, and adaptation when field signals reveal gaps.
en.c_i4_body: Performance dashboards and cycle-by-cycle variance analysis built in from the start. Results measured against a pre-defined baseline, not against internal perception of progress.
en.c_i5_body: Structured review cadence, escalation paths, and accountability frameworks to maintain commercial discipline beyond the initial deployment, institutionalizing the logic, not just the output.
en.c_i6_h3: Feeding results back into the operation
en.c_i6_body: What Arm C learns in execution is not lost. Structured and returned to the analytical models, the data infrastructure, and the priority framework, so every cycle is more informed than the last.
en.loop_h2:
Execution feeds the operation.
The operation improves.
en.loop_lead: Every cycle returns structured learning to Arm A and Arm B, making the data richer, the models sharper, and the decisions more precise. The operation compounds.
en.ln_l_body: Results feed back into A & B

b_families.label: Pricing & commercial investment
mods: Pricing
We design prices with economic rigor, demand sensitivity, and behavioral validation.
Promotion Intelligence
We measure which promotions create value and which only displace volume or destroy margin.
Commercial Policy
We make visible how net price erodes from list to pocket, and give teams the tools to redirect trade spend with measurable return.
Marketing & ROMI
We allocate the marketing budget by real return, not by engagement: every dollar goes where it pays off at the margin.

b_families.label: Portfolio & channel
mods: OBPPC & Portfolio Design
We design the right offer for each occasion, format, price point, and channel, and identify where current coverage leaves demand uncaptured.
Assortment
What goes on shelf, in which store, and at what priority.
Channel & Route-to-Market
We prioritize channels by value potential, capacity to win, and commercial coherence.

b_families.label: Customer & growth
mods: Segmentation & ICP
We segment customers and markets by what actually drives value, and define who to win and who to serve.
Retention & Revenue Quality
We measure not just how much is sold, but how durable that revenue is.
Loyalty Program
We design the loyalty program as an economic lever: mechanics, tiers, and benefits calibrated to program economics and customer lifetime value.

b_families.label: Focus & decision
mods: Leadership Alignment Compass
Before any lever is optimized, objectives must be clear and trade-offs agreed.
Competitive Intelligence
We read the competitive set continuously, in price, portfolio, and positioning.
Scenario Engine
A simulation layer across all capabilities, to test decisions before committing them.

en.a_signals_h2:
We integrate what already exists.
We capture what's missing.
en.a_signals_lead: Arm A does not assume the data exists. First it consolidates the information the operation already has, scattered and unharmonized; then it captures what is not yet visible.
en.a_sig_market_p: The external market made observable: competition, prices, and what happens at the point of sale.
en.a_sig_floor_p: The physical floor made observable: shopper, journey, shelf, and the sales conversation, read with computer vision and audio.
en.modes_h2: We operate the intelligence engine, or we equip the client's team.
en.modes_lead: Execution is delivered in two modes, depending on where it is needed.
en.modes_operators_p: In capabilities like Concierge or Market Signal, Imberion operates the intelligence engine end-to-end. Concierge runs omnichannel customer interaction (takes orders, recommends, and serves) through the Companion, a conversational layer with live dashboards; Market Signal runs the market radar. AI does the work; we operate the engine. Nothing to operate on the client side.
en.modes_enablers_p: When the work belongs inside the client's organization, we build the capability: ways of working, RGM playbooks, dashboards, and governance, so the internal team runs the operation and the decisions stick.
en.a_consol_p: The transactional, POS, and distributor data the operation already has: scattered, in different formats, and unharmonized. We capture, clean, harmonize, and consolidate it into a single reliable base.

es.hf_c_sub: Nos quedamos hasta capturar el valor
es.a_h2:
Construimos la visibilidad
que aún no existe.
es.a_lead: La mayoría de las organizaciones no puede ver su mercado con claridad, no porque la data no exista, sino porque nunca se consolidó en una base confiable. El Brazo A resuelve eso antes de que cualquier otra cosa sea posible.

es.a_s3_body: Data transaccional de cadenas de retail y formatos de comercio moderno.
es.a_s4_body: Conexiones estructuradas para recibir y mapear ventas, cobertura, precios y data promocional.
es.a_s5_body: Fuentes agregadas de terceros para benchmarking y lecturas a nivel de mercado.
es.a_s6_body: Master de SKUs, listas de precio, calendarios promocionales y registros de inventario.
es.a_u1_body: Captura en campo de precios, inventario, promociones, visibilidad, presencia competitiva y cumplimiento.
es.a_u2_body: Inteligencia a nivel de ruta de equipos comerciales que operan en el punto de venta.
es.a_u3_body: Cumplimiento de surtido, share de anaquel, ejecución de precios y visibilidad de exhibiciones promocionales.
es.a_u4_body: Precios observados de la competencia en punto de venta, por canal, región y formato.
es.a_u5_body: Investigación externa y benchmarks de categoría que dan contexto más allá de la data interna.
es.a_u6_body: Inteligencia del lado de la demanda para complementar la data transaccional y de oferta.
es.a_p1_body: Captura directa desde sistemas POS, encuestas, apps e integraciones. El punto de entrada de toda la información comercial.
es.a_p2_body: Carga técnica de múltiples fuentes en una arquitectura común, sin importar formato, cadencia u origen.
es.a_p3_body: Corrección, validación, deduplicación y resolución de inconsistencias. La base confiable empieza aquí.
es.a_p4_body: Estandarización de SKUs, clientes, canales y geografías para que la data sea comparable entre fuentes.
es.a_p5_body: Generación de datasets estructurados y utilizables para analytics, benchmarking y eventual monetización.
es.conn_bc_right: C, Ejecución y Captura de Valor
es.b_lead: Trece capacidades analíticas que convierten data comercial estructurada en decisiones priorizadas, organizadas en cuatro familias. Los trade-offs, explícitos. Decisiones, no reportes.
es.b_screenshot_caption: Interfaz de modelado de precios y escenarios
es.c_h2:
Nos quedamos hasta
que el valor sea capturado.
es.c_lead: La mayoría de los proyectos se detiene en la recomendación. El Brazo C es donde el trabajo se vuelve real, inteligencia traducida en acción de campo, medida contra el baseline y retroalimentada a la operación.
es.c_gap_note: La distancia entre un buen análisis y un resultado comercial medible es donde fallan la mayoría de los proyectos de consultoría. No entregamos el deck y nos desconectamos.
es.c_i1_body: El output del Brazo B se convierte en una lista de acciones específica y secuenciada, qué se hace primero, qué se hace después, qué no se hace, con responsables y plazos definidos.
es.c_i2_body: Las decisiones se estructuran en planes listos para campo por equipo comercial, trade, cuentas clave y territorio, con la especificidad que requiere la ejecución, no solo la comunicación.
es.c_i3_h3: Trabajando junto a los equipos de ejecución
es.c_i3_body: No entregamos el plan y nos vamos. Trabajamos junto a los equipos responsables de la ejecución hasta que la lógica opera sola, entrenamiento, soporte en tiempo real y adaptación cuando el campo revela brechas.
es.c_i4_body: Dashboards de desempeño y análisis de varianza ciclo a ciclo, integrados desde el inicio. Los resultados se miden contra un baseline predefinido, no contra la percepción interna del avance.
es.c_i5_body: Cadencia de revisión estructurada, rutas de escalación y marcos de responsabilidad para mantener la disciplina comercial más allá del despliegue inicial, institucionalizando la lógica, no solo los resultados.
es.c_i6_h3: Retroalimentando los resultados a la operación
es.c_i6_body: Lo que el Brazo C aprende en la ejecución no se pierde. Se estructura y retorna a los modelos analíticos, la infraestructura de datos y el marco de prioridades, para que cada ciclo sea más informado que el anterior.
es.loop_h2:
La ejecución alimenta la operación.
La operación mejora.
es.loop_lead: Cada ciclo retorna aprendizaje estructurado al Brazo A y al Brazo B, la data es más rica, los modelos más precisos y las decisiones más informadas. La operación se acumula.
